rawContent: @TaranaBurke began the #metoo movement in 2006 envisioning healing for those who wouldn’t have access to it another way. @aliciagarza @RaceForward #FacingRace

Take the white women off the table. Take the media off the table. Let’s talk about our work. We are constantly bombarded with a narrative that #metoo is about everyone but survivors. @TaranaBurke @RaceForward #FacingRace
The #1 thing in BIPOC communities is that the #metoo movement has forgotten us. It isn’t defined by what the media has told us. We are the movement. @TaranaBurke @RaceForward #FacingRace
Don’t opt out of the #metoo movement and then criticizing it. Stop allowing white people to take away your power. This is ours. @TaranaBurke @RaceForward #FacingRace
This isn’t about @TaranaBurke owning something. This is our movement. Stop opting out of it and start saying the #metoo movement is in all of our work. It’s everywhere. @RaceForward #FacingRace

This is our movement if we say it is. These issues will exist when Hollywood moves onto something else. Don’t turn over your power to define our issues, needs, work to people who have never been invested in our future. @TaranaBurke @RaceForward #FacingRace #metoo

It breaks my heart when Black women come to me and say that #metoo isn’t for them. It is heartbreaking to see other people attempt to take over our stuff and then we give it up. @TaranaBurke @RaceForward #FacingRace
